method_summary: audit the rendered product before choosing a visual intervention
preserve product truth and authority boundaries
prioritize semantic structure, hierarchy, and usability
implement a small number of high-impact changes
verify responsive, accessible, reduced-motion, and production states
claim_boundary: The five cases support qualitative observations inside one product and repository. They do not establish statistical improvement, independent evaluator agreement, universal transfer, or admission.
known_failures: One accumulated browser-context run exhausted local Chromium socket resources; closing obsolete contexts restored the existing test suites.
The method did not define a repository-level strategy for Windows CRLF conversion of byte-frozen evidence.
Dynamic operational labels and horizontal-rail discovery still require explicit localization and comprehension review.
limitations: No no-skill experimental baseline was retained.
No independent evaluator agreement or user task-completion study was captured.
Transfer across unrelated repositories, brands, teams, and technology stacks is not established.
Long-term maintainability after later product changes is not established.
